settings.heading: One technique-first method. Every age group.
settings.subhead:
A club develops players when there's a single line connecting U8 to U18 that every coach understands and runs the same way. The TEKKY™ is that line for technical development — a smaller-ball, touch-first method that drops into any age group, any coaching level, with output you can measure.

Bring European technical methodology to your whole program.

settings.value_heading: Why a DOC standardizes on the TEKKY™
settings.method_quote: The best academies don't start with tactics. They start with touch. The TEKKY™ brings that club-wide.
settings.method_cite: Built by Philip Lund + Paul Hanson [dot] ECNL [dot] MLS Next [dot] college
settings.close_body: 30 minutes with Philip and Paul — in person in WA or video anywhere. We'll tailor the curriculum to your age groups and walk through roster and bulk pricing.

settings.title: The line that connects your age groups
settings.body: A methodology every coach runs the same way, so a player's technical base is built deliberately from your youngest teams up - not left to chance per coach.

settings.title: Development you can actually track
settings.body: Touches are countable. Set the protocol and progress shows up in first touch, both feet, and how players hold up a level - visible at evaluations.

settings.title: Works at every coaching level
settings.body: Volunteer parent-coach or licensed staff - the ball does the teaching. The smaller surface forces the right reps without a technical director in every session.

settings.title: What families are evaluating
settings.body: Parents are deciding whether your club builds technique or just runs scrimmages. A named technical methodology plus a home program is a reason to commit.

settings.heading: Book a demo or get roster pricing
settings.body: Tell us your club, age groups, and roster size. We'll tailor the curriculum and send bulk pricing. Philip and Paul personally read every message.
